question: Which techniques does software S0154 (Cobalt Strike) use?

answer.headline: Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
answer.narrative: Cobalt Strike (S0154) utilizes numerous MITRE ATT&CK techniques, including SSH (T1021.004), Process Argument Spoofing (T1564.010), Local Accounts (T1078.003), Internal Proxy (T1090.001), and DLL Injection (T1055.001). Its capabilities also encompass techniques like Service Execution (T1569.002), RDP (T1021.001), Ingress Tool Transfer (T1105), Pass the Hash (T1550.002), and various discovery methods such as Software Discovery (T1518) and Remote System Discovery (T1018). Additionally, the software can use command-line tools like Windows Command Shell (T1059.003) and Python (T1059.006), as well as exploitation and obfuscation methods like Exploitation for Privilege Escalation (T1068) and Obfuscated Files or Information (T1027).
